_comment: deputyOS TrueNAS Scale VM template. Maps to TrueNAS Scale's `vm.create` + `vm.device.create` API shape (libvirt-backed, JSON-over-WebSocket). Use README.md in this directory for the click-through path. Defaults: 2 vCPU, 2 GB RAM, OVMF, virtio NIC, virtio-blk disk pointing at a zvol that holds the deputyOS qcow2. Substitute the zpool name (`tank`) below for whatever your SCALE host uses.
name: deputyos
description: deputyOS personal AI appliance — see https://www.deputyos.com
_devices_comment: TrueNAS Scale models VM devices as a separate collection; the SCALE UI assembles them under the parent VM. The shape below is what `vm.device.create` accepts. Adjust the zvol path to match your zpool.

devices._dtype_comment: DISK = virtio-blk attached to a zvol. Create the zvol from a qcow2 with: zfs create -V 8G tank/deputyos; qemu-img convert -O raw <qcow2> /dev/zvol/tank/deputyos
NIC = virtio bridged to the host's primary interface. Replace `br0` with your bridge if you've renamed it.
VNC for first-boot console. deputyOS bakes serial-getty too; SCALE doesn't expose serial-only VMs in the UI today, so VNC is the click-through path.

limitations._comment: Surfaced in the SCALE UI as informational text — not a SCALE schema field. Mirrors docs/14-limitations.md §'proxmox / unraid / truenas'.
limitations.no_ab_updates: Updates require replacing the zvol contents; A/B partitions are not wired.
limitations.no_pcie_passthrough_documentation: TrueNAS supports PCIe passthrough but deputyOS does not bundle Coral/Hailo/GPU runtimes for the truenas target.
